summary: The set of f with |ιₚ L(T f)| ≤ r is an O_ι-submodule, so it suffices to treat the generators finHeisOp(x)θ°. Write θ° through the vacuum expansion of the vector F of `exists_finitePart_of_isTightFrame` for a tight frame of length M², M = p(dN₁)⁶ + 1 prime to p: the coefficients are p-adically integral, and each T(translate of F) is, by the product formula, a theta product of the required kind.

Take a generator finHeisOp(x)θ°, x ∈ integralAfter(δ, above p).
